title: Projection-normalized support comparison with the designated strict tower
statement: For the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], a separated finite-type morphism f:X→Y of separated finite-type geometric-field schemes, an invertible coefficient prime, and a fixed compactification c, there is a CompactSupportReductionTowerConstruction with tower exactly the designated choice in [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor]. Its tower and total-limit functors have triangulated shift structures. The actual integral support functor, followed by the full constructible inclusion, is naturally isomorphic to the source inclusion followed by this tower and its total limit. This isomorphism preserves every chosen Roos projection to the compact-support finite term. No recollement boundary, image triangle, or rational/common-stage assertion is included.

source.place: Clause (3): the recollement-image argument, source triangle and exact compact-support realization

proof.text: Take exactly the tower, evaluation isomorphisms, normalized scalar structures and triangulated shift supplied by lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor. Use the canonical coefficientConstantTowerLimit and its complex-level derived unit for the limit fields. Descend each ordinary inverse-limit projection through the right-derived universal property. Its K-injective normalization identifies it with coefficientConstantTowerProjection; the factorization equation then proves the required unit-projection equation on all complexes. The standard right-derived inverse-limit functor has its triangulated shift structure.

Apply constructibleIntegralSupport_eq from def-sf-constructible-exceptional-compositor-data to identify the supplied support functor with the published normalized integral functor. Apply lem-pod-compact-support-normalized-tower-limit to the designated tower and its unchanged evaluations. Rewrite the support equality to obtain the required natural isomorphism and every chosen Roos projection equation. Assemble these fields with the two triangulated shift structures. This uses the whole-tower normalized comparison, not reconstruction of derived tower maps from evaluations.

theorem sfPackageIntegralSupportTowerNormalization
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D}
    [IsSeparated X.obj.hom] [IsSeparated Y.obj.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k)) (c : Compactification f.hom.left) :
    (fun [_products : HasCountableProducts
        (DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource C.l E Y.obj.left))] ↦
      ∃ T : CompactSupportReductionTowerConstruction C.l E f.hom.left c,
      T.tower = Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (exists_compactSupportReductionTower C.l E D.k X.obj.left Y.obj.left
          f.hom.left hl c))).2.2 ∧
      ∃ (sT : T.tower.CommShift ℤ) (sL : T.limit.CommShift ℤ),
      (fun [_shiftT : T.tower.CommShift ℤ] ↦ T.tower.IsTriangulated) (_shiftT := sT) ∧
      (fun [_shiftL : T.limit.CommShift ℤ] ↦ T.limit.IsTriangulated) (_shiftL := sL) ∧
      ∃ e : S.higher.integral.support f c ⋙
          (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Y.obj.left).ι ≅
          (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι ⋙ (T.tower ⋙ T.limit),
        ∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) (m : ℕ),
          HEq (e.hom.app K ≫ (T.projections m).app (T.tower.obj K.obj) ≫
              (T.evaluations m).hom.app K.obj)
            (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (exists_isDerivedLimit_and_iso
              (sfCompactSupportTerm C.l E c K.obj)
              (sfCompactSupportTransition C.l E c K.obj)).1) ≫
                Pi.π (sfCompactSupportTerm C.l E c K.obj) m))
      (_products := integralOperationsDerivedCountableProducts C.l E Y.obj.left)
